summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are on a camping trip in Omadai, a village near Kofu, in Yamanashi Prefecture, accompanied by Professor Agasa and Ran. Later they witness an arguing couples who then leaves. They then set up the tent in the couple's area. Later, the couple returns demanding their place back and the girlfriend decides to let them have it. Later Ran is drugged and kidnapped.
